15. 	"google.golang.org/grpc"
16. )
17. 
18. var (
19. 	modeFlag           = flag.String("mode", "good", "plugin mode to use (one of [good, bad])")
20. 	registerConfigFlag = flag.Bool("registerConfig", false, "register the configuration service")
21. )
22. 
23. func main() {
24. 	flag.Parse()
25. 
26. 	switch *modeFlag {
27. 	case "good":
28. 		flag.Parse()
29. 		builtIn := testplugin.BuiltIn(*registerConfigFlag)
30. 		pluginmain.Serve(
31. 			builtIn.Plugin,
32. 			builtIn.Services...,
33. 		)
34. 	case "bad":
35. 		goplugin.Serve(&goplugin.ServeConfig{
36. 			HandshakeConfig: goplugin.HandshakeConfig{
37. 				ProtocolVersion:  99,
38. 				MagicCookieKey:   "BAD",
39. 				MagicCookieValue: "BAD",
40. 			},
41. 			Plugins: map[string]goplugin.Plugin{
42. 				"BAD": &badHCServerPlugin{},
43. 			},
44. 			GRPCServer: goplugin.DefaultGRPCServer,
45. 		})
46. 	default:
47. 		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "bad value for mode: must be one of [good,bad]")
48. 		os.Exit(1)
49. 	}
50. }
51.

53. 	goplugin.NetRPCUnsupportedPlugin

62. }

44. func loadExternal(ctx context.Context, config externalConfig) (*pluginImpl, error) {
45. 	// TODO: honor context cancellation... unfortunately go-plugin doesn't seem
46. 	// to give us a mechanism for this, so we'd have to spin up some goroutine
47. 	// to watch for cancellation and start killing clients and closing
48. 	// connections and the like.
49. 
50. 	// Resolve path to an absolute path. We don't want to rely on PATH
51. 	// environment lookups for security reasons.
52. 	path, err := filepath.Abs(config.Path)
53. 	if err != nil {
54. 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to resolve plugin path: %w", err)
55. 	}
56. 
57. 	cmd := pluginCmd(path, config.Args...)
58. 
59. 	var secureConfig *goplugin.SecureConfig
60. 	if config.Checksum != "" {
61. 		secureConfig, err = buildSecureConfig(config.Checksum)
62. 		if err != nil {
63. 			return nil, err
64. 		}
65. 	} else {
66. 		config.Log.Warn("Plugin checksum not configured")
67. 	}
68. 
69. 	logger := log.NewHCLogAdapter(
70. 		config.Log,
71. 		config.Name,
72. 	)
73. 
74. 	// Start the external plugin.
75. 	pluginClient := goplugin.NewClient(&goplugin.ClientConfig{
76. 		HandshakeConfig: goplugin.HandshakeConfig{
77. 			ProtocolVersion:  1,
78. 			MagicCookieKey:   config.Type,
79. 			MagicCookieValue: config.Type,
80. 		},
81. 		Cmd: cmd,
82. 		// TODO: Enable AutoMTLS if it is fixed to work with brokering.
83. 		// See https://github.com/hashicorp/go-plugin/issues/109
84. 		AutoMTLS:         false,
85. 		AllowedProtocols: []goplugin.Protocol{goplugin.ProtocolGRPC},
86. 		Plugins: map[string]goplugin.Plugin{
87. 			config.Name: &hcClientPlugin{config: config},
88. 		},
89. 		Logger:       logger,
90. 		SecureConfig: secureConfig,
91. 	})
92. 
93. 	// Ensure the loaded plugin is killed if there is a failure.
94. 	defer func() {
95. 		if err != nil {
96. 			pluginClient.Kill()
97. 		}
98. 	}()
99. 
100. 	// Create the GRPC client and ensure it is closed on error.
101. 	grpcClient, err := pluginClient.Client()
102. 	if err != nil {
103. 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to launch plugin: %w", err)
104. 	}
105. 	defer func() {
106. 		if err != nil {
107. 			grpcClient.Close()
108. 		}
109. 	}()
110. 
111. 	// Dispense the client, which invokes the GRPCClient method in the
112. 	// hcClientPlugin. The result of that method call is returned here, which
113. 	// is coerced back into the correct type.
114. 	rawPlugin, err := grpcClient.Dispense(config.Name)
115. 	if err != nil {
116. 		return nil, err
117. 	}
118. 
119. 	plugin, ok := rawPlugin.(*hcPlugin)
120. 	if !ok {
121. 		// Purely defensive. This should never happen since we control what
122. 		// gets returned from hcClientPlugin.
123. 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("expected %T, got %T", plugin, rawPlugin)
124. 	}
125. 
126. 	// Plugin has been loaded and initialized. Ensure the plugin client is
127. 	// killed when the plugin is closed.
128. 	plugin.closers = append(plugin.closers, closerFunc(pluginClient.Kill))
129. 
130. 	info := pluginInfo{
131. 		name: config.Name,
132. 		typ:  config.Type,
133. 	}
134. 
135. 	return newPlugin(ctx, plugin.conn, info, config.Log, plugin.closers, config.HostServices)
136. }

146. func (p *hcClientPlugin) GRPCServer(b *goplugin.GRPCBroker, s *grpc.Server) error {
147. 	return errors.New("not implemented host side")
148. }

150. func (p *hcClientPlugin) GRPCClient(ctx context.Context, b *goplugin.GRPCBroker, c *grpc.ClientConn) (interface{}, error) {
151. 	// Manually start up the server via b.Accept since b.AcceptAndServe does
152. 	// some logging we don't care for. Although b.AcceptAndServe is currently
153. 	// the only way to feed the TLS config to the brokered connection, AutoMTLS
154. 	// does not work yet anyway, so it is a moot point.
155. 	listener, err := b.Accept(private.HostServiceProviderID)
156. 	if err != nil {
157. 		return nil, errs.Wrap(err)
158. 	}
159. 
160. 	server := newHostServer(p.config.Name, p.config.HostServices)
161. 
162. 	var wg sync.WaitGroup
163. 	wg.Add(1)
164. 	go func() {
165. 		defer wg.Done()
166. 		if err := server.Serve(listener); err != nil && !errors.Is(err, grpc.ErrServerStopped) {
167. 			p.config.Log.WithError(err).Error("Host services server failed")
168. 			c.Close()
169. 		}
170. 	}()
171. 
172. 	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(ctx)
173. 	wg.Add(1)
174. 	go func() {
175. 		defer wg.Done()
176. 		<-ctx.Done()
177. 		if !gracefulStopWithTimeout(server) {
178. 			p.config.Log.Warn("Forced timed-out host service server to stop")
179. 		}
180. 	}()
181. 
182. 	return &hcPlugin{
183. 		conn:    c,
184. 		closers: closerFuncs(cancel, wg.Wait),
185. 	}, nil
186. }
187. 
188. type hcPlugin struct {
189. 	conn    grpc.ClientConnInterface
190. 	closers closerGroup
191. }

193. func buildSecureConfig(checksum string) (*goplugin.SecureConfig, error) {
194. 	sum, err := hex.DecodeString(checksum)
195. 	if err != nil {
196. 		return nil, errors.New("checksum is not a valid hex string")
197. 	}
198. 
199. 	hash := sha256.New()
200. 	if len(sum) != hash.Size() {
201. 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("expected checksum of length %d; got %d", hash.Size()*2, len(sum)*2)
202. 	}
203. 
204. 	return &goplugin.SecureConfig{
205. 		Checksum: sum,
206. 		Hash:     sha256.New(),
207. 	}, nil
208. }

140. 
141. 	config externalConfig
142. }

146. func (p *hcClientPlugin) GRPCServer(b *goplugin.GRPCBroker, s *grpc.Server) error {
147. 	return errors.New("not implemented host side")
148. }
149. 
150. func (p *hcClientPlugin) GRPCClient(ctx context.Context, b *goplugin.GRPCBroker, c *grpc.ClientConn) (interface{}, error) {
151. 	// Manually start up the server via b.Accept since b.AcceptAndServe does
152. 	// some logging we don't care for. Although b.AcceptAndServe is currently
153. 	// the only way to feed the TLS config to the brokered connection, AutoMTLS
154. 	// does not work yet anyway, so it is a moot point.
155. 	listener, err := b.Accept(private.HostServiceProviderID)
156. 	if err != nil {
157. 		return nil, errs.Wrap(err)
158. 	}
159. 
160. 	server := newHostServer(p.config.Name, p.config.HostServices)
161. 
162. 	var wg sync.WaitGroup
163. 	wg.Add(1)
164. 	go func() {
165. 		defer wg.Done()
166. 		if err := server.Serve(listener); err != nil && !errors.Is(err, grpc.ErrServerStopped) {
167. 			p.config.Log.WithError(err).Error("Host services server failed")
168. 			c.Close()
169. 		}
170. 	}()
171. 
172. 	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(ctx)
173. 	wg.Add(1)
174. 	go func() {
175. 		defer wg.Done()
176. 		<-ctx.Done()
177. 		if !gracefulStopWithTimeout(server) {
178. 			p.config.Log.Warn("Forced timed-out host service server to stop")
179. 		}
180. 	}()
181. 
182. 	return &hcPlugin{
183. 		conn:    c,
184. 		closers: closerFuncs(cancel, wg.Wait),
185. 	}, nil
186. }

188. type hcPlugin struct {
189. 	conn    grpc.ClientConnInterface
190. 	closers closerGroup
191. }

193. func buildSecureConfig(checksum string) (*goplugin.SecureConfig, error) {
194. 	sum, err := hex.DecodeString(checksum)
195. 	if err != nil {
196. 		return nil, errors.New("checksum is not a valid hex string")
197. 	}
198. 
199. 	hash := sha256.New()
200. 	if len(sum) != hash.Size() {
201. 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("expected checksum of length %d; got %d", hash.Size()*2, len(sum)*2)
202. 	}
203. 
204. 	return &goplugin.SecureConfig{
205. 		Checksum: sum,
206. 		Hash:     sha256.New(),
207. 	}, nil
208. }

21. type externalConfig struct {
22. 	// Name of the plugin
23. 	Name string
24. 
25. 	// Type is the plugin type (e.g. KeyManager)
26. 	Type string
27. 
28. 	// Path is the path on disk to the plugin.
29. 	Path string
30. 
31. 	// Args are the command line arguments to supply to the plugin
32. 	Args []string
33. 
34. 	// Checksum is the hex-encoded SHA256 hash of the plugin binary.
35. 	Checksum string
36. 
37. 	// Log is the logger to be wired to the external plugin.
38. 	Log logrus.FieldLogger
39. 
40. 	// HostServices are the host service servers provided to the plugin.
41. 	HostServices []pluginsdk.ServiceServer
42. }

44. func loadExternal(ctx context.Context, config externalConfig) (*pluginImpl, error) {
45. 	// TODO: honor context cancellation... unfortunately go-plugin doesn't seem
46. 	// to give us a mechanism for this, so we'd have to spin up some goroutine
47. 	// to watch for cancellation and start killing clients and closing
48. 	// connections and the like.
49. 
50. 	// Resolve path to an absolute path. We don't want to rely on PATH
51. 	// environment lookups for security reasons.
52. 	path, err := filepath.Abs(config.Path)
53. 	if err != nil {
54. 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to resolve plugin path: %w", err)
55. 	}
56. 
57. 	cmd := pluginCmd(path, config.Args...)
58. 
59. 	var secureConfig *goplugin.SecureConfig
60. 	if config.Checksum != "" {
61. 		secureConfig, err = buildSecureConfig(config.Checksum)
62. 		if err != nil {
63. 			return nil, err
64. 		}
65. 	} else {
66. 		config.Log.Warn("Plugin checksum not configured")
67. 	}
68. 
69. 	logger := log.NewHCLogAdapter(
70. 		config.Log,
71. 		config.Name,
72. 	)
73. 
74. 	// Start the external plugin.
75. 	pluginClient := goplugin.NewClient(&goplugin.ClientConfig{
76. 		HandshakeConfig: goplugin.HandshakeConfig{
77. 			ProtocolVersion:  1,
78. 			MagicCookieKey:   config.Type,
79. 			MagicCookieValue: config.Type,
80. 		},
81. 		Cmd: cmd,
82. 		// TODO: Enable AutoMTLS if it is fixed to work with brokering.
83. 		// See https://github.com/hashicorp/go-plugin/issues/109
84. 		AutoMTLS:         false,
85. 		AllowedProtocols: []goplugin.Protocol{goplugin.ProtocolGRPC},
86. 		Plugins: map[string]goplugin.Plugin{
87. 			config.Name: &hcClientPlugin{config: config},
88. 		},
89. 		Logger:       logger,
90. 		SecureConfig: secureConfig,
91. 	})
92. 
93. 	// Ensure the loaded plugin is killed if there is a failure.
94. 	defer func() {
95. 		if err != nil {
96. 			pluginClient.Kill()
97. 		}
98. 	}()
99. 
100. 	// Create the GRPC client and ensure it is closed on error.
101. 	grpcClient, err := pluginClient.Client()
102. 	if err != nil {
103. 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to launch plugin: %w", err)
104. 	}
105. 	defer func() {
106. 		if err != nil {
107. 			grpcClient.Close()
108. 		}
109. 	}()
110. 
111. 	// Dispense the client, which invokes the GRPCClient method in the
112. 	// hcClientPlugin. The result of that method call is returned here, which
113. 	// is coerced back into the correct type.
114. 	rawPlugin, err := grpcClient.Dispense(config.Name)
115. 	if err != nil {
116. 		return nil, err
117. 	}
118. 
119. 	plugin, ok := rawPlugin.(*hcPlugin)
120. 	if !ok {
121. 		// Purely defensive. This should never happen since we control what
122. 		// gets returned from hcClientPlugin.
123. 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("expected %T, got %T", plugin, rawPlugin)
124. 	}
125. 
126. 	// Plugin has been loaded and initialized. Ensure the plugin client is
127. 	// killed when the plugin is closed.
128. 	plugin.closers = append(plugin.closers, closerFunc(pluginClient.Kill))
129. 
130. 	info := pluginInfo{
131. 		name: config.Name,
132. 		typ:  config.Type,
133. 	}
134. 
135. 	return newPlugin(ctx, plugin.conn, info, config.Log, plugin.closers, config.HostServices)
136. }

173. 	wg.Add(1)

176. 		<-ctx.Done()
177. 		if !gracefulStopWithTimeout(server) {
178. 			p.config.Log.Warn("Forced timed-out host service server to stop")
179. 		}
180. 	}()
181. 
182. 	return &hcPlugin{
183. 		conn:    c,
184. 		closers: closerFuncs(cancel, wg.Wait),
185. 	}, nil
186. }

205. 		Checksum: sum,

17. 	"github.com/zeebo/errs"
18. 	"google.golang.org/grpc"
19. )
20. 
21. type externalConfig struct {
22. 	// Name of the plugin
23. 	Name string
24. 
25. 	// Type is the plugin type (e.g. KeyManager)
26. 	Type string
27. 
28. 	// Path is the path on disk to the plugin.
29. 	Path string
30. 
31. 	// Args are the command line arguments to supply to the plugin
32. 	Args []string
33. 
34. 	// Checksum is the hex-encoded SHA256 hash of the plugin binary.
35. 	Checksum string
36. 
37. 	// Log is the logger to be wired to the external plugin.
38. 	Log logrus.FieldLogger
39. 
40. 	// HostServices are the host service servers provided to the plugin.
41. 	HostServices []pluginsdk.ServiceServer
42. }
43. 
44. func loadExternal(ctx context.Context, config externalConfig) (*pluginImpl, error) {
45. 	// TODO: honor context cancellation... unfortunately go-plugin doesn't seem
46. 	// to give us a mechanism for this, so we'd have to spin up some goroutine
47. 	// to watch for cancellation and start killing clients and closing
48. 	// connections and the like.
49. 
50. 	// Resolve path to an absolute path. We don't want to rely on PATH
51. 	// environment lookups for security reasons.
52. 	path, err := filepath.Abs(config.Path)
53. 	if err != nil {
54. 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to resolve plugin path: %w", err)
55. 	}
56. 
57. 	cmd := pluginCmd(path, config.Args...)
58. 
59. 	var secureConfig *goplugin.SecureConfig
60. 	if config.Checksum != "" {
61. 		secureConfig, err = buildSecureConfig(config.Checksum)
62. 		if err != nil {
63. 			return nil, err
64. 		}
65. 	} else {
66. 		config.Log.Warn("Plugin checksum not configured")
67. 	}
68. 
69. 	logger := log.NewHCLogAdapter(
70. 		config.Log,
71. 		config.Name,
72. 	)
73. 
74. 	// Start the external plugin.
75. 	pluginClient := goplugin.NewClient(&goplugin.ClientConfig{
76. 		HandshakeConfig: goplugin.HandshakeConfig{
77. 			ProtocolVersion:  1,
78. 			MagicCookieKey:   config.Type,
79. 			MagicCookieValue: config.Type,
80. 		},
81. 		Cmd: cmd,
82. 		// TODO: Enable AutoMTLS if it is fixed to work with brokering.
83. 		// See https://github.com/hashicorp/go-plugin/issues/109
84. 		AutoMTLS:         false,
85. 		AllowedProtocols: []goplugin.Protocol{goplugin.ProtocolGRPC},
86. 		Plugins: map[string]goplugin.Plugin{
87. 			config.Name: &hcClientPlugin{config: config},
88. 		},
89. 		Logger:       logger,
90. 		SecureConfig: secureConfig,
91. 	})
92. 
93. 	// Ensure the loaded plugin is killed if there is a failure.
94. 	defer func() {
95. 		if err != nil {
96. 			pluginClient.Kill()
97. 		}
98. 	}()
99. 
100. 	// Create the GRPC client and ensure it is closed on error.
101. 	grpcClient, err := pluginClient.Client()
102. 	if err != nil {
103. 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to launch plugin: %w", err)
104. 	}
105. 	defer func() {
106. 		if err != nil {
107. 			grpcClient.Close()
108. 		}
109. 	}()
110. 
111. 	// Dispense the client, which invokes the GRPCClient method in the
112. 	// hcClientPlugin. The result of that method call is returned here, which
113. 	// is coerced back into the correct type.
114. 	rawPlugin, err := grpcClient.Dispense(config.Name)
115. 	if err != nil {
116. 		return nil, err
117. 	}
118. 
119. 	plugin, ok := rawPlugin.(*hcPlugin)
120. 	if !ok {
121. 		// Purely defensive. This should never happen since we control what
122. 		// gets returned from hcClientPlugin.
123. 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("expected %T, got %T", plugin, rawPlugin)
124. 	}
125. 
126. 	// Plugin has been loaded and initialized. Ensure the plugin client is
127. 	// killed when the plugin is closed.
128. 	plugin.closers = append(plugin.closers, closerFunc(pluginClient.Kill))
129. 
130. 	info := pluginInfo{
131. 		name: config.Name,
132. 		typ:  config.Type,
133. 	}
134. 
135. 	return newPlugin(ctx, plugin.conn, info, config.Log, plugin.closers, config.HostServices)
136. }
137. 
138. type hcClientPlugin struct {
139. 	goplugin.NetRPCUnsupportedPlugin
140. 
141. 	config externalConfig
142. }
143. 
144. var _ goplugin.GRPCPlugin = (*hcClientPlugin)(nil)
145. 
146. func (p *hcClientPlugin) GRPCServer(b *goplugin.GRPCBroker, s *grpc.Server) error {
147. 	return errors.New("not implemented host side")
148. }
149. 
150. func (p *hcClientPlugin) GRPCClient(ctx context.Context, b *goplugin.GRPCBroker, c *grpc.ClientConn) (interface{}, error) {
151. 	// Manually start up the server via b.Accept since b.AcceptAndServe does
152. 	// some logging we don't care for. Although b.AcceptAndServe is currently
153. 	// the only way to feed the TLS config to the brokered connection, AutoMTLS
154. 	// does not work yet anyway, so it is a moot point.
155. 	listener, err := b.Accept(private.HostServiceProviderID)
156. 	if err != nil {
157. 		return nil, errs.Wrap(err)
158. 	}
159. 
160. 	server := newHostServer(p.config.Name, p.config.HostServices)
161. 
162. 	var wg sync.WaitGroup
163. 	wg.Add(1)
164. 	go func() {
165. 		defer wg.Done()
166. 		if err := server.Serve(listener); err != nil && !errors.Is(err, grpc.ErrServerStopped) {
167. 			p.config.Log.WithError(err).Error("Host services server failed")
168. 			c.Close()
169. 		}
170. 	}()
171. 
172. 	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(ctx)
173. 	wg.Add(1)
174. 	go func() {
175. 		defer wg.Done()
176. 		<-ctx.Done()
177. 		if !gracefulStopWithTimeout(server) {
178. 			p.config.Log.Warn("Forced timed-out host service server to stop")
179. 		}
180. 	}()
181. 
182. 	return &hcPlugin{
183. 		conn:    c,
184. 		closers: closerFuncs(cancel, wg.Wait),
185. 	}, nil
186. }
187. 
188. type hcPlugin struct {
189. 	conn    grpc.ClientConnInterface
190. 	closers closerGroup
191. }
192. 
193. func buildSecureConfig(checksum string) (*goplugin.SecureConfig, error) {
194. 	sum, err := hex.DecodeString(checksum)
195. 	if err != nil {
196. 		return nil, errors.New("checksum is not a valid hex string")
197. 	}
198. 
199. 	hash := sha256.New()
200. 	if len(sum) != hash.Size() {
201. 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("expected checksum of length %d; got %d", hash.Size()*2, len(sum)*2)
202. 	}
203. 
204. 	return &goplugin.SecureConfig{
205. 		Checksum: sum,
206. 		Hash:     sha256.New(),
207. 	}, nil
208. }

29. const unrecognizedRemotePluginMessage = `Unrecognized remote plugin message: %s
30. This usually means
31.   the plugin was not compiled for this architecture,
32.   the plugin is missing dynamic-link libraries necessary to run,
33.   the plugin is not executable by this process due to file permissions, or
34.   the plugin failed to negotiate the initial go-plugin protocol handshake
35. %s`
36. 
37. // If this is 1, then we've called CleanupClients. This can be used
38. // by plugin RPC implementations to change error behavior since you
39. // can expected network connection errors at this point. This should be
40. // read by using sync/atomic.
41. var Killed uint32 = 0
42. 
43. // This is a slice of the "managed" clients which are cleaned up when
44. // calling Cleanup
45. var managedClients = make([]*Client, 0, 5)
46. var managedClientsLock sync.Mutex
47. 
48. // Error types
49. var (
50. 	// ErrProcessNotFound is returned when a client is instantiated to
51. 	// reattach to an existing process and it isn't found.
52. 	ErrProcessNotFound = errors.New("Reattachment process not found")
53. 
54. 	// ErrChecksumsDoNotMatch is returned when binary's checksum doesn't match
55. 	// the one provided in the SecureConfig.
56. 	ErrChecksumsDoNotMatch = errors.New("checksums did not match")
57. 
58. 	// ErrSecureNoChecksum is returned when an empty checksum is provided to the
59. 	// SecureConfig.
60. 	ErrSecureConfigNoChecksum = errors.New("no checksum provided")
